verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an official MCP server that external AI agents connect to. That is the server role, a different story. Nothing in the pack shows Penpot itself acting as an MCP client that loads external MCP servers and uses their tools. The Figma-migration line describes an outside agent connecting both MCP servers, not Penpot consuming one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
